title: P104: hosted main 902 skips F595 on #7605 — conditional κ 0.00365074956598 (CLEAR-content premise)
body:
**Conditional κ = 0.0036507495659836771294** (×1.0000836 over #7605's 0.0036504442446).

## The premise (read this first)
Owned CLEAR #44 (owned field 1557, chart 595, event 42713) erases `{451:−1, 1495:1}` where #7605 erases `{451:−1, 902:−3/2, 985:−3/2, 1495:1}`. The claim holds only if `owned_erasure` lets that CLEAR discard the different, two-term row. The other 73 of 74 CLEARs, all 1,569 rows, all end charts, the owned MOVEs (47), the 74 lifetimes and the peak (50) are #7605's. If the premise is refused, #7605's κ stands and this word is void. Whether `owned_erasure` admits a different erased row is open upstream (`research/p104-6372-clear-form-gap`, Q1). `check.py` prints both rows and asserts that this is the only difference.

## What changed
#7605's word with one edit: hosted main 902 climbs 3→618 in one MOVE instead of 3→595→618 (six events deleted, one inserted, net −5; per native call 4 ADDs and 1 MOVE fewer). The pair 3→618 is already used by #7605, so there is no new chart pair. Native paid delta {1:−1, 2:−1, 3:+1}; complete invoice paid 110,366 → 110,349, productive 22,461, S = 1,424.

## Price
- `compare_recursive_invoices.py` vs #7605: `uniformly_better`, paid {1:−17, 2:−17, 3:+17}.
- `evaluate_recursive_power.py`: `new_cost_lower` at C = 0.0036507495659 and at #7605's 0.003650444244716; `new_cost_higher` at 0.0036507495660.
- Separation gate, run offline by us (not in the package): γ 0.940932, δ 0.908149, both < 31/32.

## Method
Frame-perp duality: the dual word is a cost-identical admissible native. Running the token-settled drop scan (#7601) on the dual explores the V-side edit class; the drop was then rebuilt and replayed exactly on the primal word.

## Caveats
- The deleted `1495 += −3/2·902` fed owned 1557, and 1557 lives only at chart 595, so no local repair exists. An exact linear search over extra ADDs among registers live at 595 is inconsistent; a repair needs a new MOVE (which repays the saved positions) or an extra owned lifetime.
- Same framework assumptions as #7605 (`native_all_columns`, `owned_erasure`, `compiler`, `precision_tape`, `analytic_recovery`, signed #7113 caller, BIT premise); #7605's caller, precision/tape counts and ordinary bill are not rerun. No human review.

## Checks
`python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-dual-scan-drop-902` passes locally (about 3.5 min): exact replay and legality, erased-content diff, seven rejecting controls, official price tools.
